name: Quantum Engraving #007 — Triple Phase Boundary
description:
A profound thermodynamic intersection in laser micro-machining: within a microscopic domain, the three fundamental states of silicon coexist under intense photon flux. Cold rigid crystalline silicon lattice (deep sapphire and indigo) borders a swirling incandescent liquid silicon melt pool (glowing amber and liquid gold), while a celestial plume of atomic vapor and gas (luminous white and violet haze) ascends above the laser epicenter.

Conceptually derived from Master's Thesis research in Nanophotonics and numerical simulations in COMSOL Multiphysics ('Modeling and implementation of laser engraving considering the impact of layers material', University of Tabriz). This artwork visualizes phase fraction equations (Lf = flc2hs(T - Tm, 50)) and energy conservation with latent heats of fusion (Lm = 1.8 x 10^6 J/kg) and vaporization (Lv = 1.278 x 10^7 J/kg).

Note: This artwork is an artistic interpretation inspired by multiphysics simulations and theoretical models; it does not claim to be a raw numerical export.
creator: Alireza Mahdipour Shadkam
